title: New Transmitter not connecting, Sensor Status stuck on 'Stopped', multiple queued items in Status page. Nothing is working... HELP!
symptom: After changing transmitter and hitting 'forget device', the sensor status is stuck on 'Stopped' with a permanent notification, and multiple queued items appear in the status page. New sensor and transmitter are not connecting despite resetting phone and restarting app.
fix: jamorham suggests double-checking the transmitter ID, keeping the G6 status tab open to watch for scanning/connecting, and if it proceeds, stop sensor and start sensor again. opasha suggests changing to specific settings (shown in a screenshot) and restarting the collector, waiting 5 minutes.
evidence_quote: please double double check that you have the new transmitter id entered correctly. Keep the G6 status tab open and watch it for 5 minutes - does it proceed from scanning to connecting with the transmitter? If so then select stop sensor and then start sensor and try again.
